  "phoneNote": "The layout is clear and bold, but styling the phone number and repair prices as Slovenian car license plates is nonsensical for an appliance repair service.",

  "fixes": [
    "Replace the car license plate styling (blue 'SLO' strip) on the phone number and price badges with a motif that fits appliance repair, such as an appliance rating label or clean industrial tag.",
    "Arrange the 'Kako poteka popravilo' steps into a 3-column horizontal grid on desktop to use the full width of the container.",
    "Increase the brightness or contrast of the blue 'Najhitreje me dobite po telefonu' label over the dark hero background so it is easier to read."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, phone numbers and prices are styled as Slovenian car license plates ('SLO' blue strip), which makes no sense for a home appliance repair business."
  ]
}
